environment.description: ECS Fargate task running with task role arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/archive-processor-role. Container runs as root (default). EFS volume mounted at /opt/app with no access point restrictions. PostgreSQL RDS instance with DB_USER=app_processor having full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables. No read-only filesystem enforcement. SQS queue accepts messages from any authenticated principal in the account.

config.filesystem: read-write EFS mount at /opt/app, no chroot
config.db_privileges: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_processor
config.task_role: full S3 read, SQS consume, no filesystem restrictions
